description: Build the music bed and the full mix. With a voice-over, the music ducks under the voice. With voiceOver false, the video has background music only: no narration, the character does not speak and the narration stays on screen as captions. Moods: pop = Bright pop played on real recorded instruments (acoustic guitar, piano, bass, real drums); acoustic = Warm acoustic on real instruments (fingerpicked guitar, piano, shaker); lofi = Soft lo-fi (electric piano, round bass, light drums); piano = Calm piano, no drums; upbeat = Bright and light (nylon guitar, claps); halloween = Playful Halloween music box (celesta, A minor, no drums); none = No music, voice only.

soundEffects.description: Real sound effects on the animation: whooshes on transitions, pops when items appear, a chime on the title and end cards. Default on.

voiceOver.description: false = background music only, no voice-over. true = switch back to a voice-over (generate_voice first). Omit to keep the current choice.
